flashcards.a: Random 60-90 minutes (~75 avg); configurable only via Graph token-lifetime policies, 10 min to 24 h max.

flashcards.q: What did CAE change about token lifetimes?
flashcards.a: CAE-aware sessions stretch access tokens to up to 28 hours; revocation happens near-real-time (<=~15 min) via critical events instead of expiry.

flashcards.q: Since when are refresh/session token lifetimes non-configurable?
flashcards.a: January 30, 2021. Session length is now controlled by Conditional Access sign-in frequency (default ~90-day rolling window).

flashcards.q: System-assigned vs user-assigned managed identity lifecycle?
flashcards.a: System: 1:1 with resource, auto-deleted with it. User-assigned: standalone resource, attachable to many compute resources; Microsoft's recommended default.
169.254.169.254; ~5 req/s general, managed-identity category ~20 req/s with 5 concurrent requests - cache tokens in-process.

flashcards.q: Why can permission changes take hours to affect a workload using groups?
flashcards.a: Backend caches MI tokens per resource URI for ~24 h; group/role claims are frozen at mint time. Grant roles directly to the identity to avoid the group-claim path.

flashcards.q: Do managed identities work across tenants?
flashcards.a: No. Cross-tenant machine auth needs workload identity federation (max 20 FICs per identity/app) or multi-tenant app registrations.

flashcards.q: Azure RBAC evaluation order in one line?
flashcards.a: Deny assignment wins absolutely; otherwise ANY allow anywhere in the inherited scope chain grants; default deny.

flashcards.q: Control plane vs data plane example that bites people?
flashcards.a: Subscription Owner cannot read blobs - blob reads need Storage Blob Data Reader (data-plane role). Key Vault secrets need Key Vault Secrets User.

flashcards.q: Rough Azure RBAC numbers worth knowing?
flashcards.a: ~700 built-in roles, ~4000 role assignments per subscription, propagation takes minutes to tens of minutes.

flashcards.q: Licensing and P2 additions for Conditional Access?
flashcards.a: P1 required for any CA policy; P2 adds Identity Protection risk signals (sign-in/user risk) plus PIM JIT elevation. CA does not cover service principals.

flashcards.q: Groups overage threshold in a JWT and symptom?
flashcards.a: >~200 groups (SAML ~150): token emits _claim_names pointing at Graph instead of inline groups; naive apps silently see zero memberships.
Two cloud-only emergency accounts excluded from all CA policies, credentials sealed, any use alerts - tested regularly.

flashcards.q: How do AKS pods get Entra identity without secrets?
flashcards.a: Workload identity: projected service-account token exchanged via federated identity credential trusting the cluster OIDC issuer; subject = ns:sa.

flashcards.q: Name a real-world limit-related failure mode with managed identity creation in automation.
flashcards.a: A Terraform apply creating many user-assigned identities in a tight loop within one subscription/region can hit the 80-creates-per-20-seconds throttle before the tenant-wide 400/20s limit, producing retriable throttling errors that look like generic API failures unless the specific limit is known.
